cloud.title: Alexa voice control (optional)
cloud.description: Leave this empty unless you need it. Mirroring your Alexa devices into HomeKit needs nothing here. This is only for the reverse direction — giving Alexa voice control over Homebridge accessories that aren't already in your Alexa account. Link your account at https://cloud.johncarroll.dev/switchboard and paste the token below. It's verified offline against an embedded public key; no device data or email leaves your network.

alexa.title: Alexa account
alexa.description: Mirrors every device linked to your Alexa account (Smart Life skill, Sengled paired to Echo, etc.) into HomeKit by talking to Alexa's smart-home API with a captured session cookie. Generate the cookie by running `node scripts/alexa-login-proxy.cjs` from the plugin directory — see README.
